messages:
maya: who's up for a sunrise paddle + ramen after? thinking saturday 7am. weather looks good :sun_with_face:
alejandro: ooh paddle then ramen = perfect. count me in. where at?
maya: meet at pier 7 at 6:30, bring layers. ramen spot suggestion: Ichiro on 4th, opens 9.
jen: i can do sunday instead, saturday i've got a family thing. any sunday options?
sam: I can do saturday but late — maybe join ramen only. 10:30+ okay?
maya: @sam yep. ramen reservation for 10:45 works. I'll try to get a table for 6.
lunch-bot: :calendar: Maya reserved a table at Ichiro for 6 people at 10:45 on Sat — confirmation #R12345
jen: nice! also, anyone down for boardgame night Sat evening? small group at my place.
alejandro: count me for boardgames. what should I bring?
jen: snacks and a simple game (codenames, wingspan) — but bring whatever you're attached to :)
maya: bringing a crowd-pleaser dip. can't do evening though — gotta catch a red-eye.
sam: I'll swing by after ramen. ping me the address, @jen
jen: 123 Maple St, bring shoes to switch into. DM me for deets.
maya: thanks all, I'll create a small event in calendar. :party_parrot:
alejandro: woo weekend plan locked. :raised_hands:
sam: see y'all!
